title: polypodium lineare var. ussuriense
intro: Polypodium lineare var. ussuriense, commonly known as the Ussuri Linearpoly, is a type of fern plant species. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with benefits including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic effects, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Polypodium lineare var. ussuriense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
